name: search_records
description: Search Rosa's indexed health records (medications, pill descriptions, appointments, visit notes, lab results, allergies, care team, insurance, vaccines). Call this BEFORE answering any question about her health or care. Pass the question in plain English keywords, e.g. 'pink pill', 'advil knee pain', 'heart doctor appointment'.

query.description: Short keyword query in English describing what to look up.

name: get_medication_schedule
description: Get Rosa's medications for a time of day, with dose, what each pill looks like, and what it is for. Use for 'what do I take tonight', 'which pills in the morning'.

name: get_appointments
description: List Rosa's appointments with date, time, address and how to prepare.

name: analyze_lab_trend
description: Run a trend analysis on one of Rosa's lab measurements over time (code runs in a secure Daytona sandbox). Returns first and latest values, change, direction, and whether it is at goal. Use for 'is my sugar getting better', 'how is my cholesterol'.

test.description: Which measurement. a1c = blood sugar average.

name: request_refill
description: Send a refill request for one of Rosa's prescriptions to Harbor Pharmacy and the prescribing doctor. Only call after Rosa says yes.

name: notify_family
description: Send a text message to Rosa's daughter Ana to keep her in the loop. Use after an action (refill, appointment prep), when Rosa asks, when a question needs a human or a doctor, or with urgency 'urgent' for any emergency.

message.description: Short message to Ana in English, written by cuida about her mom.

urgency.description: How fast Ana should look at it.
